Text: The support console shall offer the points-history CSV export only to users with the support agent role or the support team lead role.
Rationale: Members who dispute a balance ask support for a statement (LOY-131); Finance already receives the warehouse extract.

Text: WHEN a support agent requests a points-history export for a member, the support console shall generate a CSV file with one row per points transaction of that member in the columns of R-021.
Rationale: The file must show what the agent sees on screen so that agent and member discuss the same data.

Text: The support console shall let the support agent choose the export period within the 24 months of R-020, with the last 3 months preselected.
Rationale: Disputes usually concern recent transactions; the support lead marked the period choice as nice to have.

Text: WHEN a support agent requests a points-history export of up to 2,000 transactions, the support console shall start the file download within TBD seconds.
Rationale: The agent exports during a call with the member; the target is open question Q8.

Text: WHEN a support agent exports a member's points history, the loyalty service shall record the agent ID, the member ID, the export period and the timestamp in the audit log.
Rationale: The export takes personal data out of the system; support and Finance (SH-03) want each export traceable.

Text: The loyalty service shall not keep a copy of a points-history export file after the download to the agent's browser completes.
Rationale: Keeps exported personal data out of server storage under the retention policy DRP-2024 (S-05).
